description.text: The Champion's League was Japan's invitation-only Pokémon Card Game championship from 2000 to 2007. At first it brought together the champions of past official tournaments; from 2003 it was the national final for the winners of that year's Battle Road, and its top four in each age division were named the Elite Four. Early winners got an engraved medal. From 2005 the Elite Four won a trophy card, Takumi Akabane's cosmos holo Stadium Champion's League, which only Champion's Leaguers may use and which makes them play with their hand shown; it was redrawn with Dialga and Palkia in 2007, the last year, and from 2008 the Japan National Championships took its place. The name was later reused for Japan's open tournament circuit, the Champions League.
